attrQuote: The birth of beBird stands on the shoulders of many open-source giants. We are grateful for the contributions of the following outstanding resources and communities.
leafletQuote: The core open-source JavaScript engine powering beBird's interactive map experience, lightweight and highly performant.
ebirdQuote: Provides the core global bird observation data for our site, serving as the cornerstone for ecological exploration.
tomorrowQuote: Delivers high-precision real-time weather and forecast data, helping birders plan trips under optimal weather conditions.
sunriseQuote: A lightweight and reliable sunrise and sunset time calculation service, making dawn and dusk observation plans more precise.
nominatimQuote: Provides reliable reverse geocoding services, converting coordinates into detailed address and region information.
flaticonQuote: Animated icons that add vitality to the weather information panel.
lovartQuote: A high-quality source of artistic design assets that gives the website its unique visual style and texture.
